Data Security Manager

# Data Encryption and Key Management

Encrypt sensitive data across hybrid multicloud and centralize enterprise key management with a secure, unified solution. Mitigate risk of data breaches and ensure absolute control over data access.

[![Request a Demo](https://no-cache.hubspot.com/cta/default/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5.png)](https://cta-redirect.hubspot.com/cta/redirect/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5)

## Encrypt Data Everywhere

Encryption is your last line of defense. From file system to database encryption to data masking and tokenization, Fortanix enables you to secure data at every layer across all your environments and avoid paying millions in data loss or regulatory fines.

![File System Encryption](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fdata-security-manager%2Ffolder.webp&w=96&q=75)

###### File System Encryption

Go beyond full disk encryption and protect individual file systems, actively in-use on a designated host.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/filesystem-encryption)

![Transparent Database Encryption](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fdata-security-manager%2Fvisibility.webp&w=96&q=75)

###### Transparent Database Encryption

Manage cryptographic keys for databases like Oracle, SQL Server, and MongoDB, securing them on FIPS-validated HSMs.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/solutions/data-encryption/transparent-database-encryption)

![Data Tokenization](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fdata-security-manager%2Fdata.webp&w=96&q=75)

###### Data Tokenization

Anonymize data while preserving its integrity and structure by tokenizing sensitive data sets like PANs, PHI, and PII.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/data-tokenization)

## Enterprise Key Management

Store, search, rotate, and retire cryptographic keys on a single platform that gives you full control. Apply encryption policy with few clicks and drive consistent security. Fortanix makes compliance and data sovereignty easy, securing all of your keys and secrets on high-performance HSMs offered as a service.

![Key Management Service (KMS)](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fkey.webp&w=96&q=75)

###### Key Management Service (KMS)

Simplify key lifecycle administration across hybrid multicloud environments.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/key-management-service)

![Hardware Security Module (HSM)](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2FVault.webp&w=96&q=75)

###### Hardware Security Module (HSM)

Securely generate, store, and use cryptographic keys and other assets.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/hardware-security-module)

Fortanix seamlessly integrates with cloud-based and legacy key management services with [multicloud key management.](https://www.fortanix.com/solutions/enterprise-key-management/multicloud-key-management "")

- [AWS KMS External Key Store (XKS](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/xks-for-aws ""))
- [Google External Key Manager (EKM)](https://www.fortanix.com/solutions/enterprise-key-management/ekm-for-gcp "")
- [Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)](https://www.fortanix.com/solutions/enterprise-key-management/bring-your-own-key-hold-your-own-key "")

Add even more scale and support for high transaction volumes on the Fortanix platform.
